justifications.Diagnosis specificity: Symptoms are specific (founder bottleneck, two accounts), but candidate diagnoses lack support/counter-evidence and confirmed diagnosis is vague.
justifications.Crux quality: Crux is clear but not sharply framed; whyNow is generic and alternatives are not mutually exclusive.
justifications.Alternative quality: Three alternatives are distinct but lack detailed validation and tradeoffs are superficial.
justifications.Choice clarity: Decision is clear but lacks explicit criteria and tradeoff analysis; winning aspiration is vague.
justifications.Evidence traceability: Most statements are traceable to source responses, but some AI inferences lack evidence and limitations are acknowledged.
justifications.Assumption quality: Assumptions are listed but unvalidated; no prioritization or testing plan.
justifications.Action coherence: Actions align with decision but lack sequencing and dependencies; stop-defer is explicit.
justifications.Execution testability: Measures are vague ('needs validation') and lack baselines; evidence gate is testable but incomplete.
justifications.Governance integrity: Risks are placeholders; no approval chain or escalation; decision record is incomplete.

judge.notes: Report is adequate but lacks depth in validation and specificity; many placeholders reduce quality.
